whatChanged: NEW: Grant Thornton Advisors, backed by New Mountain Capital, to acquire CBIZ for $5bn ($55/share cash, ~54% premium), creating the fifth-largest US professional services firm (cbz-grant-thornton-acquisition)
NEW: CMS Energy exits non-utility renewables development at NorthStar Clean Energy, selling non-Michigan assets and cutting parent funding needs by $500m+ through 2030 (cms-northstar-renewables-exit)
NEW: Boston Scientific launches a global restructuring with $700-800m of pre-tax charges through 2029, targeting ~$500m of annual savings and including job cuts (bsx-global-restructuring)
ADVANCED: Arcadis boards unanimously reject WSP Global's revised EUR51.50-per-share proposal as fundamentally undervaluing the company (rumored → rumored)
DROPPED: 1 stale deal (no new phase in 21+ days: qgen-pe-consortium-takeover-interest)

themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: UK-listed names remain a magnet for control-changing bids: Apollo's agreed £5.7bn take-private of easyJet still awaits a firm offer by its August 7 deadline (ezj-apollo-takeover), Prologis's 'best and final' £14bn proposal for Segro has the board minded to recommend with the PUSU deadline extended to August 12 (pld-sgro-takeover-bid), and CD&R-owned OCS Group's agreed GBP3.1bn takeover of Mitie will remove another name from the LSE entirely (ocs-mitie-acquisition).

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: PE-, founder- and strategic-led buyouts keep pulling listed names private: Grant Thornton and New Mountain Capital's $5bn all-cash deal for CBIZ (cbz-grant-thornton-acquisition), Apollo's £5.7bn take-private of easyJet (ezj-apollo-takeover), Steel Partners' $16.75/share bid for InMode (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), Perfect Corp.'s founder-led going-private deal (perf-projectny-going-private), EQT's A$22.50/share approach for Perpetual that the board rejected while offering to engage further (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid), Frasers Group's EUR38/share tender for Hugo Boss now unconditional (boss-frasers-takeover-offer), Stripe and Advent's $53bn+ offer for PayPal still live after board rejection (pypl-stripe-advent-takeover-bid), OCS Group's CD&R-backed takeover of Mitie (ocs-mitie-acquisition), and privately held Sazerac's revived ~$15bn approach for Brown-Forman (bfb-sazerac-takeover-bid).

themes.label: AI data-center capacity and power build-out
themes.note: Capital and commercial commitments keep pouring into the physical layer of AI compute: Nvidia's talks to backstop ~$250bn of financing for OpenAI's 10GW Ohio campus (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop) and its equity-plus-Vera-Rubin-capacity pact with Safe Superintelligence (nvda-ssi-partnership), the new $10bn Naver AI factory scaling to 200MW with Brookfield capital (naver-nvda-ai-factory-partnership), Orange and Morrison's EUR3bn, 400MW French data-centre JV (ora-morrison-datacenter-jv), Meta's Louisiana campus expanded to 5GW and $50bn+ (meta-richland-parish-capex), Williams's $5.34bn Blackstone-led JV funding five behind-the-meter data-center power projects (wmb-blackstone-power-jv), 3M and Microsoft's optical-infrastructure partnership for Azure (mmm-msft-ai-datacenter-partnership), Microsoft's at-scale deployment of AMD's Helios systems (msft-amd-helios-partnership), NVIDIA's $1.5bn prepaid packaging capacity at Amkor (amkr-nvidia-packaging-partnership), Verizon's $1bn dark-fiber deal with Google (vz-google-fiber-partnership), Alphabet's 2026 capex guide raised to as much as $205bn (googl-capex-raise-2026), Samsung Electronics' ~$200bn memory and foundry MOU with Broadcom (samsungelec-avgo-chip-partnership), and SK hynix's long-term HBM pact with NVIDIA behind a 2GW Vera Rubin AI factory (skhynix-nvda-ai-partnership).

themes.label: Chipmakers funding the customers that buy their chips
themes.note: Vendor financing is now the standard shape of frontier-AI deals, and it concentrates credit and equity risk on the supplier's balance sheet: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee ~$250bn of lease and debt financing for OpenAI's Ohio campus (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop), took a reported ~$5bn equity stake in pre-revenue Safe Superintelligence alongside a compute commitment (nvda-ssi-partnership), and is buying ~4.5% of Naver via a ~$1bn share issue tied to a 200MW AI factory (naver-nvda-ai-factory-partnership), while AMD is investing up to $5bn in Anthropic against a tens-of-billions MI450 purchase commitment (amd-anthropic-chip-partnership).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep drawing legal fire: the signed, DOJ-cleared Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger is formally paused by court stipulation until five days after an antitrust trial or June 1, 2027, with Paramount owing ~$7m/day if the pause runs past September 30, 2026 (psky-wbd-acquisition), while InMode's special committee remains procedurally frozen pending the Haifa court's ruling on the competing buyout bids (inmd-steel-partners-buyout).
